title: Carnivores, Herbivores, Omnivores
seo_title: Year 1 Science: Carnivores, Herbivores and Omnivores Worksheets
standard_text: Identify and name a variety of common animals that are carnivores, herbivores and omnivores.
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on carnivores, herbivores and omnivores: what animals eat, sorting animals by diet and teeth as clues. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Carnivores eat other animals. Omnivores eat both.
body_html:
How to think about it

Animals eat different things.

  • Herbivores eat only plants.
  • Carnivores eat only other animals.
  • Omnivores eat plants and animals.
Example

A cow eats grass. It is a?

Only plants

Answer: herbivore

Example

A fox eats mice and berries. It is an?

Both

Answer: omnivore

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all big animals eat meat.
  • Thinking rabbits eat meat.
  • Thinking humans only eat plants.

faq.q: What is the difference between a herbivore, a carnivore and an omnivore?
faq.a: Herbivores eat only plants, carnivores eat only other animals, and omnivores eat both plants and animals.
Humans are omnivores, because our bodies can eat both plants and animals.

faq.q: How can teeth help us tell?
faq.a: Sharp, pointed teeth are good for meat. Flat teeth are good for chewing plants.
